column1: # S2-NOTE normalisation map (TXE2-S2NOTE, 9 Oct 2026). Built read-free from two sources only: benchmark-tx/txeng2/s2read/sheet_SIGNS.md
# (the S2 readers' sheet) and the label inventory with counts of benchmark-tx/outputs/vivonne1573-f103r-confirm2/committed.tsv.
# Written and committed before the truth file or any per-position error was opened. Lines starting with # are ignored by tools/tx_bench.py.
# Considered and NOT mapped (each a distinct glyph on both sides by the sources' own wording):
#   z vs 3 -- sheet: '3 round-topped 3 with descender (write z only for a flat-topped z)'; committed uses both (3 x68, z x12): a glyph distinction, not notation.
#   y vs V -- sheet describes y as 'the long swash y / ꝩ that starts with a lead-in stroke from the left' and V as 'a long backslash / V stroke'; committed uses both (y x57, V x61): distinct glyphs.
#   ':' -- sheet: ': two dots side by side on the line' is ONE sign; committed carries ':' x156 as a sign: same status on both sides, nothing to map, never dropped.
#   l vs L, p vs P, a vs @ -- the sheet lists each as a separate sign; committed uses both members of each pair.

#   Z (x4), J (x1), t (x4), i (x2), w (x1) -- committed labels absent from the sheet; the sheet's wording does not say which sheet token they correspond to (Z could be z or 3; J could be j; t has no plain sheet token): left unmapped, listed as missing labels.
#   committed tokenisation fragments 'non]', '{flourish' + 'cross}' (one sign split in two), and brace descriptors: multi-token or free-text, not a label rename.
